Configured local DNS on r4 for all requested names and added MX records directing mail for `company.com` and `university.edu` to pc7 and pc11. All 40 PCs are configured to use it. The existing connections, addresses and routes remain unchanged.

The [DNS configuration](/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-5curiiew/lab/r4/etc/dnsmasq.d/lab.conf) contains the mappings, and the [README](/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-5curiiew/lab/README.md) includes sample lookup commands. The MX records identify mail hosts; they do not set up mail services.

All startup scripts passed shell syntax checks. The lab has not been started or tested end to end: the [Kathara skill](/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-5curiiew/lab/.codex/skills/kathara-creation/SKILL.md) says to “await user request to validate” after generating the scenario.
